title: Enterprise Support: outcome precision and disposition for physical-quantity reconciliation
content:
Enterprise Support — outcome precision and disposition for physical-quantity reconciliation.

## Decision basis

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Floor total equivalent vCPU-hours at zero, then round the review quantity half up to six decimal places.

## Hypothetical case

For physical-quantity reconciliation: A hypothetical nonnegative quantity of 1.2345675 rounds half up to 1.234568. A negative total is floored at zero before this quantity rounding.
